return_policy.standard_return_period: 10 days from the date of delivery
return_policy.opened_electronics: Opened electronics are eligible for return if they meet the applicable return conditions.
return_policy.unused_products: Products should be in acceptable return condition and include applicable accessories.
return_policy.refund_timeline: Approved refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days after the return is received and approved.
return_policy.return_charges: Return charges may apply depending on the reason for the return and the applicable policy conditions.
return_policy.damaged_products: Customers should report products received damaged through customer support.
return_policy.exceptions: Certain products may be excluded from return eligibility according to their applicable product-specific conditions.
